text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic young adult male character. Swept dark brown wavy hair, green-hazel eyes, square clean-shaven jaw, warm light skin; dark brown suede field jacket, sand plaid shirt and brown paisley neck scarf. One centered chest-up studio ID portrait. Straight front view, eye-level camera, upright head, level shoulders, eyes looking directly at the camera, relaxed neutral closed-mouth expression. Consistent 3:4 portrait crop, full hair visible, pure white background, soft even studio lighting, realistic skin texture. Preserve a consistent individual face and hairstyle across all views. High-detail photographic skin, anatomically natural features, no watermarks, interfaces, logos or text.
original_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. This is a targeted corrective edit of the attached studio portrait, NOT a new character design. Preserve the exact person's recognizable facial identity, age, eye color, skin tone, hair, facial hair, freckles/moles, clothing and accessories.
MANDATORY CORRECTION: restage this same person in a rigorously straight-on, eye-level passport photograph. Correct the existing subtle head rotation/lean AND skewed facial landmark alignment. Zero head roll, zero yaw, zero pitch. Face plane parallel to camera sensor, eye-level camera centered directly in front of nose; head centered above neck, chin neither raised nor tucked. Both shoulders square to camera and on a level line. Equal perspective on the two cheeks, jaw sides and ears. Centers of both pupils lie on a perfectly horizontal line. Nose bridge, nose tip, philtrum, midpoint of lips and chin centered on the same vertical axis. The eyes look directly forward into the lens, no sideways glance, no looking upward from under brows. Preserve natural individual anatomy while removing pose-related skew; do NOT mirror-copy one half of the face.
EXPRESSION MUST BE COMPLETELY NEUTRAL AT REST: relax the brow muscles, do not knit or lift eyebrows; relax eyelids to their natural open position, do not squint or stare wide-eyed. Relax cheeks and jaw. Lips gently touching with zero smile or smirk, corners level and at rest, no one-sided lip lift, no pursing, pouting or frown. No intense, seductive, angry, sad, amused or confident posing. A calm expressionless ordinary ID photo.
LOCK SERIES COMPOSITION: one individual chest-up portrait, vertical 3:4 canvas, 1086x1448 pixels. Full hair with approximately 6% top margin. Pupils at y=37% of canvas; center of chin at y=63%. Face center x=50%. Retain consistent head size and chest crop. Do not zoom in/out or enlarge head compared with series.
Solid pure white backdrop, balanced neutral soft frontal studio light, no directional shadows that create visual facial skew. Photorealistic skin texture. Preserve hair's natural asymmetric styling but face itself straight and level. No lettering, UI, border, watermarks or additional items. Return ONE corrected portrait.
reproduction_note: 独立文生图提示词按本次角色外观与成图重建；实际生成采用已确认肖像作为图像参考，原始编辑提示词另保留。独立文生图不能保证逐像素复现。
